s.note: the diner shaped like a bulldog
s.how: Cut 3 onions into thick rings and soak in 300ml buttermilk for 30 minutes. Whisk 150g flour with 250ml cold lager. Dip the rings in the batter and fry at 185C until puffed and golden. Salt and serve hot.

Dip 400g peeled green prawns in flour, beaten egg and a mix of 60g shredded coconut and 60g panko. Fry at 180C for 2 minutes. Dice a quarter pineapple with red onion, chilli and lime for salsa. Serve together.

m.note: Jenny's big night out at the club
m.how: Marinate 1kg chicken thighs in 250ml pineapple juice, 60ml soy, grated ginger and 2 garlic cloves for 2 hours. Grill, then reduce the marinade to a glaze and brush over. Cook 300g jasmine rice in 400ml coconut milk and 200ml water.

w.how: Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100ml cream. Scoop vanilla ice cream into four tall glasses, pour over the fudge and top with whipped cream and a cherry. Push a sparkler into each and light it at the table.

d.n: Bulldog Cafe root beer malt float
d.note: the counter at the Bulldog, after a good flight
d.how: Put 4 mugs in the freezer for 20 minutes. Add 2 scoops vanilla ice cream and 1 tsp malted milk powder to each. Slowly pour 250ml cold root beer down the side of each mug so the foam rises without spilling. Serve with long spoons and straws.
